description: Store a matrix that supports changing one cell and querying an inclusive rectangular sum. Example 1: for [[3,0,1],[5,6,3]], the sum of rows 0–1 and columns 0–2 is 18. Example 2: after changing cell (0,1) to 2, a query over row 0 and columns 1–2 returns 3. Constraints: the matrix is nonempty and updates and queries stay within its bounds.
intuition: A two-dimensional Fenwick tree supports point deltas and prefix sums without rebuilding a full prefix matrix.

brute_force.approach: Store the matrix and scan every cell in each requested rectangle.

optimal.approach: Maintain current values and a 2D Fenwick tree; combine four prefix sums for a rectangle.
optimal.time: update O(log rows * log columns), sumRegion O(log rows * log columns)

edge_cases: Updating a cell to its existing value has zero delta.
A one-cell query returns the current value at that cell.
